description: Default ~3 credits (limit 10; 0.3/result). Latest Reels from a public Instagram profile — isPinned, optional since date filter, pass userId to skip resolve; ceil(n×0.3) credits; nextCursor + hasMore. Costs ~3 credits (0.3/result). Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass nextCursor from the previous response (clips:{userId}:{opaque} on the native Reels path, or legacy {mediaId}_{userId}). Stop when hasMore is false.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 10, max 200). Billed per result.

since.description: Only Reels published on or after this ISO date or datetime (e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z; no offset means UTC). Pinned Reels older than since are left out without ending the list; once a page reaches an older non-pinned Reel, hasMore is false. Reels with no known date are left out. Billed on the returned Reels.

url.description: Instagram profile URL, @handle, or username. Omit when userId is set. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform.

userId.description: Instagram numeric user ID (e.g. 173560420). Skips handle→ID resolve (legacy sequential WPI alone could cost ~80s). Prefer when you already have the ID from basic-profile or profile-search.
